name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Surgimate is asking someone to be hands-on with clients while configuring a technical build in real time, and that has been my actual job for years. At Accelo, I built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and worked directly with them on API integrations and CRM configuration, not from a project-plan template alone, but by getting into the system myself.

At Wix, I directly managed a team of onboarding specialists for two years while personally onboarding 25+ clients a month, and at Birdeye I onboarded a network of 15 to 20 reseller partners, coordinating directly with Product and Engineering to resolve technical challenges during setup, the same cross-functional connective tissue this role calls for between R&D, Support, and Implementations.

I also bring something more personal to healthcare technology specifically. For about eight years I have navigated private insurance directly as a patient, fighting for approvals on physical therapy and imaging, so I understand the stakes when a process on the other side of a screen determines whether care happens on time. That is not something I am learning for this interview, it is lived experience with exactly the kind of high-stakes coordination Surgimate builds software for.
I'd welcome a conversation about how that combination fits the Onboarding Project Manager role. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
